text:
Elaine (Sales): Hey team — Stonebridge (series C fintech) is pushing to close the POC. They want a bespoke commercial: 40% off list for a 12mo, $1.8M commit. Includes Dedicated cluster + Private VPC + 24/7 support. Can we get quick Deal Desk + Finance + Legal guidance?

Jordan (Presales): ran the POC last week — perf looked great on our verified config. They require private deployment for regs (need HSM/KMS + SOC2 evidence). If we give Dedicated + VPC their ops risk goes down a lot; that'll raise infra cost for us.

Mike (Deals): 40% is pretty aggressive. What are the upsides? strategic logo / reference? TCV shape?

Elaine (Sales): Primary asks: logo + joint case study, intro to two other business units, and a 12mo commit. They said if we meet price they'll expand to 3 regions in year 2. Quick snapshot of terms: 
```
commit:
  term: 12 months
  tcv: $1,800,000
  mrr_equiv: $150,000
discount_request: 40%
addons: Dedicated (8x A100 equiv), Private VPC, 24/7 support
reference: yes (case study + exec intro)
```

Sara (Legal): We need the completed security questionnaire before final pricing. Also watch custom indemnities & data residency clauses for EU customers. No unlimited liabilities. We'll need to scope the statement of work for the Private deployment.

Tina (Finance): Running quick math — 40% would push margin under our typical floors for Dedicated + support. For $1.8M commit, internal suggested max is ~30% unless there's clear multi-year upsell + strong reference. Can we get them to sign 18 months or add a higher upfront payment?

Mike (Deals): Proposed counter: 34% off for 12mo + 2mo ramp credit + signed case study + exec intro within 6 months. If they want 40% you'd need 24mo commit or higher upfront. Thoughts?

Jordan (Presales): Tech-wise the only blocker is HSM integration window (2–4 weeks) and a short perf revalidation after Dedicated is provisioned. We can tolerate the 2mo ramp credit.

Elaine (Sales): Customer is firm on 12mo. They said 24mo not acceptable right now. They will do a case study and want the discount to land. Their procurement asked for a single approval for the bespoke rate.

Tina (Finance): If 24mo is off the table, then we should push for higher upfront (50% prepaid) or tighten SLAs for fallback. Otherwise risk to ops/costs too high.

Mike (Deals): Deal Desk — can we get an exception for 40% tied to 50% upfront + signed public case study + SOC2 + completion of security questionnaire? Otherwise counter at 34% w/ 50% upfront? @DealDesk Bot please queue for review.

DealDesk Bot: Request logged: RD-DD-2026-328. Assigned to Mike (Deals). ETA 4 biz hours.

Sara (Legal): I'll start a scoped SOW template and flag redlines for data residency. Will need the sec questionnaire answers before final sign.

Elaine (Sales): Thanks. I'll push for 50% upfront and get the secQ filled asap. If Deal Desk can provisionally ok 40% with those conditions, I can close this week. :crossed_fingers: 

Mike (Deals): Acknowledge — will triage. If we can't get 50% upfront, we'll present 34% + ramp credits.

Tina (Finance): Fine to provisionally approve conditional on 50% upfront + SOC2 + case study. Marking as finance conditional approval. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (Presales): I'll prioritize the perf revalidation once Dedicated is live.

Elaine (Sales): Great — I'll update the buyer and work the secQ. Will post updates here.

(emoji reactions: many :thumbsup: and a :eyes: from execs)
